g1.label: 1. Jake ___ basketball
g1.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Jake plays.

g2.label: 2. Maria ___ horses
g2.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Maria loves.

g3.label: 3. Emily and her friends ___ surfing
g3.why: ‘Emily and her friends’ is a plural subject, so it takes the base form ‘go’.

g4.label: 4. Tyler ___ science best
g4.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Tyler likes.

g5.label: 5. Aisha ___ in Florida
g5.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Aisha lives.

g6.label: 6. The five teenagers ___ messages
g6.why: ‘The five teenagers’ is a plural subject, so it takes the base form ‘send’.

g7.label: 7. Jake ___ not live in Texas
g7.why: Simple present negatives for he/she/it use ‘does not’, not ‘do not’.

g8.label: 8. ___ Maria want to be a vet?
g8.why: Simple present yes/no questions for he/she/it start with ‘Does’.
